spans.s:
mn. (-कः-कं)
Complete performance or preparation.
m. (-कः)
1 A wag-tail.
2 Froth, foam.
3 The trunk of a tree.
4 The upright post of a house.
5 A compound word.
6 A juggler, a cheat.
E.
तडि to beat or kill, affix वुन्.

m. (-ण्डुः)
One of ŚIVA'S doorkeepers, and one of the original teachers of the arts of dancing and mimicry.

m. (-णः)
1 A worm, an insect.
2 A fool, a blockhead.
3 The water in which rice has been soaked or steeped.
E.
तण्डुल rice, &c. ख affix, and ल changed to र.

m. (-लः)
1 Grain after threshing and winnowing, especially rice.
2 A vermifuge plant: see विडङ्ग.
3 A potherb, a sort of Amaranth, (A. polygonoides.)
E.
तड to beat, Uṇādi affix उल, and नुम् inserted.

f. (-म्बुः)
Rice water or gruel.
E.
तण्डुल, and अम्बु water.

m. (-कः)
A sort of Amaranth.
E.
ईकन् added to the preceding; also तण्डुलीय.

m. (-यः)
1 A kind of Amaranth, (A. polygonoides.)
2 Viraṅga, a vermifuge.
3 A mineral, iron pyrites.
E.
तण्डुल grain, (to which the seeds, &c. are compared,) and छ affix; also तण्डुलीयक.

f. (-लुः)
A plant of which the seeds are used as a vermifuge: see विडङ्ग.
E.
तडि to beat, affix उलु.

m. (-रः)
A sort of Amaranth: see तण्डुलीय, &c.
E.
तण्डुल, and एरक् aff.

n. (-कं)
Water in which rice has been boiled, rice gruel.
E.
तण्डुल, and उदक water.

m. (-घः)
A prickly sort of bambu, (Bambusa spinosa.)
2 A heap of grain.
E.
तण्डुल grain, &c. or (as derived from तडि to beat, to tear,) a thorn, ओघ a heap or quantity.

mn. (-वः-वं)
1 Dancing, especially with violent gesticulation, and particularly applied to the frantic dance of the god ŚIVA, and his votaries.
2 A sort of grass, (Saccharum procerum.)
m. (-बः)
In prosody, a tribrach or foot of three short syllables.
E.
तण्डु the name of the Muni, by whom the style of dancing was first taught, affix अण्; or तडि to beat, and अव aff.

m. (-कः)
A name of NANDI, one of ŚIVA'S principal attendants.
E.
ताण्डव ŚIVA'S dancing, and तालिक accompanier with music, from ताल tune or time, and ठक् aff.

m. (-यः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
ताण्डव dancing, and प्रिय fond of.

f. (-ण्डिः)
The science of dancing.
E.
तण्डु the teacher of this art, and इञ् aff.
